<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0"/>
<title>CIRQL – Campus Marketplace</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

:root{
  --black:#0a0a0a;--white:#ffffff;
  --gray-50:#f8f8f8;--gray-100:#f0f0f0;--gray-200:#e0e0e0;
  --gray-300:#c0c0c0;--gray-500:#757575;--gray-700:#424242;--gray-900:#1a1a1a;
  --accent:#23d160;--accent-dark:#1aaa4a;
  --danger:#e53e3e;--warn:#f6ad55;--blue:#3182ce;
  --font-display:'Outfit',sans-serif;
  --font-body:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;
  --radius:8px;--radius-lg:14px;
  --shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.10);--shadow-md:0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.13);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;outline:none}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:var(--font-body);background:var(--gray-50);color:var(--gray-900);font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;overflow-x:hidden}
button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:none;transition:all .18s ease}
input,select,textarea{font-family:inherit}
a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
img{display:block}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px;height:5px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:#f0f0f0}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#ccc;border-radius:5px}

/* -- TOPBAR -- */
#topbar{background:#111;color:#fff;text-align:center;padding:8px 16px;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.2px}
#topbar span{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}

/* -- NAVBAR -- */
.navbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:200;background:var(--black);border-bottom:2px solid #111}
.navbar-inner{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:0 20px;height:64px}
.logo-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;flex-shrink:0;cursor:pointer}
.logo-badge{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:5px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.logo-badge img{height:30px;width:auto}
.search-wrap{flex:1;max-width:560px;display:flex;height:42px}
.search-cat{height:100%;padding:0 12px;background:#fff;border:none;border-right:1px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:var(--radius) 0 0 var(--radius);font-size:13px;color:var(--gray-700);min-width:120px;font-family:inherit}
.search-input{flex:1;height:100%;padding:0 12px;border:none;background:#fff;font-size:14px;color:var(--gray-900)}
.search-input::placeholder{color:var(--gray-300)}
.search-btn{height:100%;padding:0 18px;background:var(--accent);border-radius:0 var(--radius) var(--radius) 0;color:#000;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.search-btn:hover{background:var(--accent-dark)}
.nav-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0;margin-left:auto}
.nav-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:40px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;transition:all .18s}
.nav-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.nav-btn-outline{border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.nav-btn-green{background:var(--accent);color:#000}
.nav-btn-green:hover{background:var(--accent-dark)}
.cart-btn{position:relative}
.cart-count{position:absolute;top:-6px;right:-6px;background:var(--danger);color:#fff;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:2px solid var(--black);display:none}
.profile-dropdown{position:relative}
.profile-btn{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),#0ea5e9);color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);cursor:pointer}
.dropdown-menu{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 10px);right:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);min-width:180px;overflow:hidden;display:none;z-index:300}
.profile-dropdown.open .dropdown-menu{display:block}
.drop-item{padding:12px 16px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--gray-700);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;width:100%;text-align:left;background:none;border:none;font-family:inherit}
.drop-item:hover{background:var(--gray-50);color:var(--gray-900)}
.drop-divider{border-top:1px solid var(--gray-100)}

/* -- NOTIF BAR -- */
#notif-bar{background:var(--accent);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;padding:9px 20px;position:sticky;top:64px;z-index:190}
.notif-text{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:#000}
.notif-enable{height:30px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:30px;background:#000;color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;flex-shrink:0}
.notif-enable:hover{background:#222}
.notif-x{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(0,0,0,.12);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;border:none;transition:all .15s;flex-shrink:0;line-height:1}
.notif-x:hover{background:rgba(0,0,0,.22)}

/* -- SUBNAV -- */
.subnav{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-200);position:sticky;top:64px;z-index:150}
.subnav-inner{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}
.subnav-inner::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.cat-pill{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 18px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--gray-700);border-bottom:3px solid transparent;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;background:none;border-left:none;border-right:none;border-top:none;font-family:inherit;transition:all .15s}
.cat-pill:hover{color:var(--black)}
.cat-pill.active{color:var(--black);border-bottom-color:var(--black);font-weight:700}
.cat-pill span{font-size:16px}

/* -- HERO -- */
.hero{background:var(--black);padding:0 20px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.hero-inner{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 380px;gap:30px;padding:36px 0;align-items:center}
.hero-content{color:#fff}
.hero-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(35,209,96,.15);border:1px solid rgba(35,209,96,.3);color:var(--accent);padding:6px 14px;border-radius:30px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:20px}
.hero h1{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:44px;font-weight:900;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-1.5px;margin-bottom:16px}
.hero h1 em{color:var(--accent);font-style:normal}
.hero p{color:#aaa;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:28px;max-width:480px}
.hero-search{display:flex;background:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);overflow:hidden;border:3px solid var(--accent);max-width:500px}
.hero-search input{flex:1;border:none;padding:14px 18px;font-size:15px;color:var(--gray-900);background:transparent;font-family:inherit}
.hero-search button{padding:0 24px;background:var(--accent);color:#000;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;border:none;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.hero-search button:hover{background:var(--accent-dark)}
.hero-stats{display:flex;gap:28px;margin-top:28px}
.stat-num{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:28px;font-weight:800;color:#fff}
.stat-lbl{font-size:12px;color:#666;margin-top:2px}
.hero-card-stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.mini-listing{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:14px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.mini-listing:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-color:rgba(35,209,96,.4)}
.mini-icon{width:48px;height:48px;background:#111;border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:24px;flex-shrink:0}
.mini-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.mini-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;margin-bottom:2px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.mini-meta{font-size:12px;color:#888}
.mini-price{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--accent);flex-shrink:0}

/* -- TRUST BAR -- */
.trust-bar{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-100);padding:16px 20px}
.trust-inner{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-around;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.trust-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--gray-700)}
.trust-icon{width:36px;height:36px;background:var(--gray-50);border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px}

/* -- PROMO BANNERS -- */
.promo-section{max-width:1320px;margin:24px auto 0;padding:0 20px}
.promo-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.promo-main{border-radius:var(--radius-lg);background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--black) 0%,#1a1a2e 100%);min-height:180px;padding:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;cursor:pointer;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.promo-main:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.promo-side{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.promo-sm{border-radius:var(--radius-lg);flex:1;min-height:83px;padding:20px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;transition:transform .18s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.promo-sm:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.promo-sm:nth-child(1){background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0f2027,#203a43,#2c5364)}
.promo-sm:nth-child(2){background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1a0800,#3d1500)}
.promo-badge-top{position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;background:var(--accent);color:#000;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:20px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px}
.promo-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.9px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);margin-bottom:5px}
.promo-title{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;font-family:var(--font-display);letter-spacing:-.4px;line-height:1.15}
.promo-sm .promo-title{font-size:15px}
.promo-cta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:var(--accent);color:#000;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:5px 13px;border-radius:20px;margin-top:12px;width:fit-content}

/* -- MAIN -- */
.main{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px 20px 60px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:220px 1fr;gap:24px}

/* -- SIDEBAR -- */
.filter-box{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:18px;margin-bottom:16px}
.filter-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gray-900);margin-bottom:14px;padding-bottom:10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-100)}
.filter-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.filter-item{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:var(--radius);cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s;border:none;background:none;font-family:inherit;width:100%;text-align:left}
.filter-item:hover{background:var(--gray-50)}
.filter-item.selected{background:#f0fdf4;color:#166534}
.filter-item-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500}
.filter-item-left span{font-size:16px}
.filter-count{font-size:11px;color:var(--gray-500);background:var(--gray-100);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:20px}
.price-inputs{display:flex;gap:8px}
.price-inp{flex:1;border:1.5px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:8px 10px;font-size:13px;color:var(--gray-900);background:#fff;transition:border .15s;font-family:inherit}
.price-inp:focus{border-color:var(--black)}
.condition-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.cond-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:6px 4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;color:var(--gray-700)}
.cond-checkbox{width:16px;height:16px;border:2px solid var(--gray-300);border-radius:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;transition:all .15s}
.cond-checkbox.checked{background:var(--black);border-color:var(--black);color:#fff}
.apply-btn{width:100%;padding:10px;background:var(--black);color:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin-top:12px;font-family:inherit;border:none;cursor:pointer}
.apply-btn:hover{background:#333}

/* -- FILTER CHIPS -- */
.filter-chips-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px}
.f-chip{height:34px;padding:0 15px;border-radius:30px;border:1.5px solid var(--gray-200);background:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--gray-700);cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;font-family:inherit}
.f-chip:hover{border-color:var(--gray-400)}
.f-chip.on{background:var(--black);color:#fff;border-color:var(--black)}

/* -- LISTINGS -- */
.listings-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:16px}
.results-text{font-size:14px;color:var(--gray-700)}
.results-text strong{color:var(--black);font-weight:700}
.sort-select{border:1.5px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:8px 12px;font-size:13px;color:var(--gray-700);background:#fff;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.sort-select:focus{border-color:var(--black)}
.view-btns{display:flex;gap:4px}
.view-btn{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:var(--radius);background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--gray-200);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.view-btn.active{background:var(--black);border-color:var(--black);color:#fff}
.listings-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:16px}
.listings-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}

/* -- PRODUCT CARD -- */
.prod-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;position:relative}
.prod-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);border-color:var(--gray-300);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.card-img{aspect-ratio:4/3;background:var(--gray-50);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:60px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.card-img-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.04;background:radial-gradient(circle,#000,transparent)}
.badge{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;z-index:2}
.badge-free{background:#dcfce7;color:#15803d}
.badge-rent{background:#eff6ff;color:#1d4ed8}
.badge-hot{background:#fef3c7;color:#d97706}
.badge-new{background:#f0f9ff;color:#0369a1}
.wishlist-btn{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;z-index:2;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:15px;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.12);border:1px solid var(--gray-200);cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.wishlist-btn:hover{background:#fff;transform:scale(1.1)}
.wishlist-btn.liked{color:var(--danger)}
.card-body{padding:12px 14px}
.card-price{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:var(--gray-900);line-height:1}
.card-price-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--gray-500);font-weight:400;margin-top:1px}
.card-name{font-size:13px;color:var(--gray-700);margin-top:5px;line-height:1.4;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.card-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--gray-100)}
.card-loc{font-size:11px;color:var(--gray-500);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}
.card-time{font-size:11px;color:var(--gray-500)}
.card-cond{display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;background:var(--gray-100);color:var(--gray-700)}
.card-cond.new{background:#dcfce7;color:#15803d}
.card-cond.like-new{background:#dbeafe;color:#1d4ed8}
.card-cond.good{background:#fef9c3;color:#854d0e}
.card-cond.fair{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b}
.card-footer{padding:0 14px 12px;display:flex;gap:6px}
.add-cart-btn{flex:1;height:36px;background:var(--black);color:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:all .15s}
.add-cart-btn:hover{background:#333}
.add-cart-btn.in-cart{background:var(--accent);color:#000}
.contact-btn{height:36px;padding:0 12px;border:1.5px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--gray-700);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;font-family:inherit;background:#fff}
.contact-btn:hover{border-color:var(--black);color:var(--black)}

/* -- LIST CARD -- */
.list-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);display:flex;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;transition:all .18s}
.list-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);border-color:var(--gray-300)}
.list-card-img{width:160px;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--gray-50);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:56px;position:relative}
.list-card-body{flex:1;padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.list-card-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.list-card-name{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--gray-900);margin-bottom:4px;line-height:1.3}
.list-card-desc{font-size:13px;color:var(--gray-500);line-height:1.5;margin-top:4px;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.list-card-price{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:22px;font-weight:900;color:var(--gray-900);text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}
.list-card-bottom{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:auto;padding-top:12px}
.list-card-actions{display:flex;gap:8px}

/* -- SKELETON -- */
.skel{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gray-100) 25%,var(--gray-200) 50%,var(--gray-100) 75%);background-size:200% 100%;animation:shimmer 1.4s ease infinite;border-radius:var(--radius)}
@keyframes shimmer{to{background-position:-200% 0}}
.skel-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);overflow:hidden}
.skel-img{aspect-ratio:4/3}
.skel-body{padding:12px 14px}
.skel-line{height:14px;margin-bottom:8px}
.skel-line.s{width:60%}

/* -- CART DRAWER -- */
.overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);z-index:500;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .3s}
.overlay.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:all}
.cart-drawer{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:400px;background:#fff;z-index:501;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);box-shadow:-10px 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
.cart-drawer.open{transform:translateX(0)}
.drawer-header{padding:20px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-100);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.drawer-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:20px;font-weight:800}
.drawer-close{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gray-100);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px;color:var(--gray-700);cursor:pointer;border:none}
.drawer-close:hover{background:var(--gray-200)}
.drawer-body{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:16px 24px}
.drawer-empty{text-align:center;padding:60px 20px}
.drawer-empty-icon{font-size:64px;margin-bottom:16px}
.drawer-empty p{font-size:15px;color:var(--gray-500)}
.cart-item{display:flex;gap:14px;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-100)}
.cart-item-icon{width:60px;height:60px;background:var(--gray-50);border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:28px;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid var(--gray-200)}
.cart-item-info{flex:1}
.cart-item-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--gray-900);margin-bottom:4px}
.cart-item-price{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--gray-900)}
.cart-item-meta{font-size:12px;color:var(--gray-500);margin-top:2px}
.cart-item-remove{padding:4px 8px;color:var(--danger);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;background:none;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;border:none;font-family:inherit}
.cart-item-remove:hover{background:#fef2f2}
.cart-qty{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:8px}
.qty-btn{width:26px;height:26px;border:1.5px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gray-700);cursor:pointer;background:#fff;transition:all .15s}
.qty-btn:hover{border-color:var(--black);color:var(--black)}
.qty-num{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--gray-900);min-width:20px;text-align:center}
.drawer-footer{padding:20px 24px;border-top:1px solid var(--gray-100)}
.summary-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:14px;color:var(--gray-700);margin-bottom:8px}
.summary-row.total{font-weight:800;font-size:16px;color:var(--gray-900);border-top:1px solid var(--gray-200);padding-top:10px;margin-top:4px}
.checkout-btn{width:100%;height:50px;background:var(--black);color:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);font-size:15px;font-weight:700;font-family:var(--font-display);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:none;cursor:pointer;margin-top:14px}
.checkout-btn:hover{background:#222}

/* -- PRODUCT DETAIL MODAL -- */
.modal-bg{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);z-index:400;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s}
.modal-bg.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:all}
.modal{background:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);width:100%;max-width:760px;max-height:90vh;overflow-y:auto;box-shadow:0 25px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.modal-header{padding:20px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-100);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.modal-close{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gray-100);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px;color:var(--gray-700);cursor:pointer;border:none}
.modal-close:hover{background:var(--gray-200)}
.modal-body-grid{padding:24px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px}
.modal-img{aspect-ratio:1;background:var(--gray-50);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:100px;border:1px solid var(--gray-200)}
.modal-price{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:32px;font-weight:900;color:var(--gray-900);margin-bottom:4px}
.modal-name{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;color:var(--gray-900);margin-bottom:12px}
.modal-desc{font-size:14px;color:var(--gray-600);line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:20px}
.detail-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:20px}
.detail-table td{padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-100)}
.detail-table td:first-child{color:var(--gray-500);width:40%}
.detail-table td:last-child{font-weight:600;color:var(--gray-900)}
.seller-card{background:var(--gray-50);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:20px}
.seller-avatar{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--black);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;font-size:18px;flex-shrink:0}
.seller-name{font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:var(--gray-900)}
.seller-loc{font-size:12px;color:var(--gray-500)}
.modal-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.modal-cart-btn{width:100%;height:46px;background:var(--black);color:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
.modal-cart-btn:hover{background:#333}
.modal-contact-btn{width:100%;height:46px;border:2px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--gray-700);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;font-family:inherit}
.modal-contact-btn:hover{border-color:var(--black);color:var(--black)}

/* MODAL CHAT SECTION */
.modal-chat-tabs{display:flex;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--gray-200);margin-bottom:14px}
.mct{padding:9px 15px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--gray-500);border-bottom:2.5px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-1.5px;cursor:pointer;background:none;border-left:none;border-right:none;border-top:none;font-family:inherit;transition:all .15s}
.mct.active{color:var(--black);border-bottom-color:var(--black);font-weight:700}
.chat-box{height:220px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.chat-msgs{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding-bottom:4px}
.bubble{max-width:78%;padding:9px 13px;border-radius:12px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
.bubble.mine{background:var(--black);color:#fff;border-bottom-right-radius:4px;align-self:flex-end}
.bubble.theirs{background:var(--gray-100);color:var(--black);border-bottom-left-radius:4px;align-self:flex-start;border:1px solid var(--gray-200)}
.bubble-time{font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);margin-top:2px;text-align:right}
.bubble.theirs .bubble-time{color:var(--gray-500)}
.chat-input-row{display:flex;gap:8px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--gray-200)}
.chat-input{flex:1;height:40px;border:1.5px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:30px;padding:0 16px;font-size:13.5px;background:var(--gray-50);font-family:inherit;transition:all .2s}
.chat-input:focus{border-color:var(--black);background:#fff}
.chat-send{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--black);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px}
.chat-send:hover{background:#333}

/* -- AUTH MODAL -- */
.auth-modal{background:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);width:100%;max-width:420px;box-shadow:0 25px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.auth-header{padding:24px 24px 0;text-align:center}
.auth-logo{display:inline-flex;background:#000;border-radius:10px;padding:7px 16px;margin-bottom:16px}
.auth-logo img{height:26px;width:auto}
.auth-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:22px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:4px}
.auth-sub{font-size:14px;color:var(--gray-500)}
.auth-tabs{display:flex;background:var(--gray-100);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:4px;gap:3px;margin:16px 24px 0}
.auth-tab{flex:1;height:36px;border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--gray-500);border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;background:none;transition:all .2s}
.auth-tab.active{background:#fff;color:var(--black);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.auth-body{padding:20px 24px 24px}
.field{margin-bottom:15px}
.field label{display:block;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gray-700);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-bottom:6px}
.field input,.field select{width:100%;height:46px;border:2px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:0 14px;font-size:14px;color:var(--gray-900);background:#fff;font-family:inherit}
.field input:focus,.field select:focus{border-color:var(--black)}
.college-detect{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent);margin-top:4px;display:none}
.auth-btn{width:100%;height:48px;background:var(--black);color:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);font-size:15px;font-weight:700;font-family:var(--font-display);border:none;cursor:pointer;margin-top:4px}
.auth-btn:hover{background:#333}
.auth-alt{text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--gray-500);padding:0 24px 20px}
.auth-alt a{color:var(--black);font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}

/* -- SELL MODAL -- */
.sell-modal{background:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);width:100%;max-width:540px;max-height:90vh;overflow-y:auto;box-shadow:0 25px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.sell-header{padding:20px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-100);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.sell-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:20px;font-weight:800}
.sell-body{padding:24px}
.sell-tabs{display:flex;background:var(--gray-100);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:4px;gap:3px;margin-bottom:18px}
.sell-tab{flex:1;height:36px;border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--gray-500);border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;background:none;transition:all .2s}
.sell-tab.active{background:#fff;color:var(--black);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.sell-btn{width:100%;height:48px;background:var(--accent);color:#000;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);font-size:15px;font-weight:700;font-family:var(--font-display);margin-top:8px;border:none;cursor:pointer}
.sell-btn:hover{background:var(--accent-dark)}
.fr2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.fpfx-wrap{position:relative}
.fpfx-sym{position:absolute;left:14px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gray-900);pointer-events:none}
.fpfx-wrap input{padding-left:26px}
.form-err{font-size:12px;color:var(--danger);margin-top:4px;display:none}
.field textarea{width:100%;min-height:90px;border:2px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:12px 14px;font-size:14px;color:var(--gray-900);background:#fff;font-family:inherit;resize:vertical;line-height:1.6;transition:border .2s}
.field textarea:focus{border-color:var(--black)}

/* -- NEWSLETTER -- */
#newsletter{background:var(--black);color:#fff}
.nl-inner{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:48px 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:36px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.nl-left h2{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:26px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.8px;line-height:1.2;text-transform:uppercase}
.nl-right{min-width:330px;flex:1;max-width:400px}
.nl-form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.nl-input-wrap{position:relative}
.nl-input-icon{position:absolute;left:15px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);pointer-events:none}
.nl-input{width:100%;height:50px;border-radius:30px;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#fff;padding:0 18px 0 44px;font-size:14px;font-family:inherit;transition:all .2s}
.nl-input::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
.nl-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.nl-btn{width:100%;height:50px;border-radius:30px;background:#fff;color:#000;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;font-family:var(--font-display);border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.nl-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.92)}
.nl-note{font-size:11.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);text-align:center}

/* -- FOOTER -- */
.footer{background:var(--black);color:#fff;padding:40px 20px 24px}
.footer-inner{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto}
.footer-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:32px;margin-bottom:32px}
.footer-brand{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:26px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-1px;margin-bottom:12px}
.footer-tagline{font-size:13px;color:#888;line-height:1.7;max-width:240px;margin-bottom:18px}
.footer-socials{display:flex;gap:8px}
.soc-btn{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;flex-shrink:0}
.soc-btn:hover{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#000}
.soc-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.footer-col-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;color:#666;margin-bottom:14px}
.footer-link{display:block;font-size:13px;color:#aaa;margin-bottom:8px;text-decoration:none;transition:color .15s}
.footer-link:hover{color:#fff}
.footer-bottom{border-top:1px solid #222;padding-top:20px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:12px;color:#555;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.footer-bottom-links{display:flex;gap:14px}
.footer-bottom-link{color:#555;text-decoration:none;font-size:12px;transition:color .15s}
.footer-bottom-link:hover{color:#aaa}

/* -- FAB -- */
.fab-post{position:fixed;bottom:28px;right:28px;z-index:100;height:52px;padding:0 22px;background:var(--accent);color:#000;border-radius:30px;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;display:none;align-items:center;gap:8px;box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(35,209,96,.4);font-family:var(--font-display);border:none;cursor:pointer}
.fab-post:hover{background:var(--accent-dark);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.fab-post.show{display:flex}

/* -- TOAST -- */
.toasts{position:fixed;bottom:24px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:1000;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;pointer-events:none;align-items:center}
.toast{background:var(--gray-900);color:#fff;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:30px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:auto;animation:toastIn .3s ease}
.toast.success{background:#15803d}
.toast.error{background:var(--danger)}
@keyframes toastIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}

/* -- EMPTY -- */
.empty-state{text-align:center;padding:64px 20px}
.es-icon{font-size:56px;margin-bottom:14px;opacity:.25}
.es-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:var(--gray-900);margin-bottom:6px}
.es-desc{font-size:14px;color:var(--gray-500)}

/* -- RESPONSIVE -- */
@media(max-width:900px){
  .hero-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hero-card-stack{display:none}
  .main{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .sidebar{display:none}
  .footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .cart-drawer{width:100%;max-width:100%}
  .modal-body-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .promo-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .subnav{top:64px}
  #notif-bar{top:0}
}
@media(max-width:600px){
  .listings-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .hero h1{font-size:28px}
  .nl-inner{flex-direction:column;padding:32px 20px}
  .nl-right{min-width:100%;max-width:100%}
  .footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- TOPBAR -->
<div id="topbar">?? Exclusive for college students — <span>Zero commission</span> on all transactions!</div>

<!-- NAVBAR -->
<nav class="navbar">
  <div class="navbar-inner">
    <div class="logo-wrap" onclick="resetHome()">
      <div class="logo-badge">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="CIRQL"/>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="search-wrap">
      <select class="search-cat" id="searchCat">
        <option value="all">All Categories</option>
        <option value="Academia">Books & Notes</option>
        <option value="Tech">Electronics</option>
        <option value="Rides">Vehicles</option>
        <option value="Living">Room & Living</option>
        <option value="Attire">Clothing</option>
        <option value="Misc">Other Items</option>
      </select>
      <input class="search-input" id="searchInput" type="text" placeholder="Search for anything on campus…" oninput="onSearch()"/>
      <button class="search-btn" onclick="onSearch()">
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="M21 21l-4.35-4.35"/></svg>
        Search
      </button>
    </div>
    <div class="nav-actions" id="navActions">
      <button class="nav-btn nav-btn-outline" id="loginBtn" onclick="openAuthModal()">
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 00-4-4H8a4 4 0 00-4 4v2"/><circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/></svg>
        Login
      </button>
      <button class="nav-btn nav-btn-green" id="signupBtn" onclick="openAuthModal()">Sign Up Free</button>
      <button class="nav-btn cart-btn" id="cartBtn" style="display:none" onclick="toggleCart()">
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="9" cy="21" r="1"/><circle cx="20" cy="21" r="1"/><path d="M1 1h4l2.68 13.39a2 2 0 001.98 1.61h9.72a2 2 0 001.98-1.61L23 6H6"/></svg>
        Cart
        <span class="cart-count" id="cartCount">0</span>
      </button>
      <div class="profile-dropdown" id="profileDrop" style="display:none">
        <button class="profile-btn" id="profileBtn" onclick="toggleProfileDrop()">?</button>
        <div class="dropdown-menu" id="dropMenu">
          <button class="drop-item" onclick="closeDrop()">?? My Listings</button>
          <button class="drop-item" onclick="closeDrop()">? Wishlist</button>
          <button class="drop-item" onclick="closeDrop()">?? My Cart</button>
          <div class="drop-divider"></div>
          <button class="drop-item" onclick="logout()">
            <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M9 21H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h4"/><polyline points="16 17 21 12 16 7"/><line x1="21" y1="12" x2="9" y2="12"/></svg>
            Logout
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</nav>

<!-- NOTIFICATION BAR -->
<div id="notif-bar">
  <div class="notif-text">?? Enable notifications for instant alerts on new campus listings</div>
  <button class="notif-enable" onclick="enableNotif()">Enable Now</button>
  <button class="notif-x" onclick="document.getElementById('notif-bar').style.display='none'">×</button>
</div>

<!-- SUBNAV -->
<div class="subnav">
  <div class="subnav-inner" id="catPills"></div>
</div>

<!-- HERO -->
<section class="hero">
  <div class="hero-inner">
    <div class="hero-content">
      <div class="hero-tag">?? Campus Only Marketplace</div>
      <h1>Buy, Sell & Rent<br/><em>on Campus</em></h1>
      <p>Zero commission trading between verified students. Books, gadgets, bikes and more — all within your college community.</p>
      <div class="hero-search">
        <input type="text" id="heroSearch" placeholder="What are you looking for?" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'){document.getElementById('searchInput').value=this.value;onSearch();}"/>
        <button onclick="document.getElementById('searchInput').value=document.getElementById('heroSearch').value;onSearch()">Search</button>
      </div>
      <div class="hero-stats">
        <div class="stat-item"><div class="stat-num">2,400+</div><div class="stat-lbl">Active Listings</div></div>
        <div class="stat-item"><div class="stat-num">18</div><div class="stat-lbl">Colleges</div></div>
        <div class="stat-item"><div class="stat-num">?0</div><div class="stat-lbl">Commission</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-card-stack" id="heroPreview"></div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- TRUST BAR -->
<div class="trust-bar">
  <div class="trust-inner">
    <div class="trust-item"><div class="trust-icon">??</div>Verified Students Only</div>
    <div class="trust-item"><div class="trust-icon">??</div>Zero Commission</div>
    <div class="trust-item"><div class="trust-icon">??</div>Campus Hyperlocal</div>
    <div class="trust-item"><div class="trust-icon">?</div>Instant Chat</div>
    <div class="trust-item"><div class="trust-icon">??</div>Eco Friendly</div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- PROMO BANNERS -->
<div class="promo-section">
  <div class="promo-grid">
    <div class="promo-main" onclick="setActiveCat('Tech')">
      <span class="promo-badge-top">Trending</span>
      <div class="promo-label">Campus Tech Hub</div>
      <div class="promo-title">Electronics &<br/>Gadgets</div>
      <div class="promo-cta">Browse Now ›</div>
    </div>
    <div class="promo-side">
      <div class="promo-sm" onclick="setActiveCat('Academia')">
        <div class="promo-label">Academic</div>
        <div class="promo-title">Books & Notes</div>
        <div class="promo-cta" style="margin-top:8px">Explore ›</div>
      </div>
      <div class="promo-sm" onclick="setActiveCat('Rides')">
        <div class="promo-label">Campus Rides</div>
        <div class="promo-title">Cycles & Bikes</div>
        <div class="promo-cta" style="margin-top:8px">View All ›</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- MAIN -->
<div class="main">
  <!-- SIDEBAR -->
  <aside class="sidebar" id="sidebar">
    <div class="filter-box">
      <div class="filter-title">Browse Category</div>
      <div class="filter-list" id="sidebarCats"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="filter-box">
      <div class="filter-title">Price Range</div>
      <div class="price-inputs">
        <input class="price-inp" id="priceMin" type="number" placeholder="Min ?" oninput="renderListings()"/>
        <input class="price-inp" id="priceMax" type="number" placeholder="Max ?" oninput="renderListings()"/>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="filter-box">
      <div class="filter-title">Condition</div>
      <div class="condition-list" id="condList"></div>
      <button class="apply-btn" onclick="renderListings()">Apply Filters</button>
    </div>
  </aside>

  <!-- LISTINGS AREA -->
  <div>
    <!-- FILTER CHIPS -->
    <div class="filter-chips-bar">
      <button class="f-chip" id="fc-free" onclick="toggleChip('free')">?? Free Only</button>
      <button class="f-chip" id="fc-rentOnly" onclick="toggleChip('rentOnly')">?? For Rent</button>
      <button class="f-chip" id="fc-likeNew" onclick="toggleChip('likeNew')">? Like New</button>
      <button class="f-chip" id="fc-myCollege" onclick="toggleChip('myCollege')">?? My College</button>
    </div>

    <div class="listings-header">
      <div class="results-text" id="resultsText"><strong>0</strong> listings found</div>
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px">
        <select class="sort-select" id="sortSel" onchange="renderListings()">
          <option value="recent">Most Recent</option>
          <option value="low">Price: Low ? High</option>
          <option value="high">Price: High ? Low</option>

<!-- TOAST STACK -->
<div class="toasts" id="toastStack"></div>

<script>
// --- COLLEGE MAP ---
const COLLEGE_MAP = {

  {id:'Rides',label:'Vehicles',icon:'??'},
  {id:'Living',label:'Room & Living',icon:'??'},
  {id:'Attire',label:'Clothing',icon:'??'},
  {id:'Misc',label:'Other Items',icon:'??'},
];

const CAT_ICONS = {Academia:'??',Tech:'??',Rides:'??',Living:'??',Attire:'??',Misc:'??'};

let LISTINGS = [
  {id:1,name:'Advanced Physics Vol. 2 – H.C. Verma',price:300,category:'Academia',icon:'??',condition:'Good',seller:'A. Sharma',location:'KIET Institute',college:'KIET',description:'Used for one semester. A few pencil marks on pages 40–60, otherwise excellent condition. Perfect for revision and competitive exams.',posted:'1h ago',views:15,type:'sell',badge:'hot'},

Verma',location:'KIET Institute',college:'KIET',description:'Purchased 6 months ago. 99% battery health. No scratches. Original box, charger and documentation included. Selling because upgraded to M3.',posted:'4h ago',views:102,type:'sell',badge:'new'},
  {id:3,name:'Room Cooler Symphony 40L',price:1200,category:'Living',icon:'??',condition:'Fair',seller:'R. Singh',location:'KIET Institute',college:'KIET',description:'Works great. Slightly noisy at high speed but cools the hostel room effectively. Water tank in good shape.',posted:'1d ago',views:45,type:'sell'},
  {id:4,name:'Royal Enfield Classic 350 – 2020',price:95000,category:'Rides',icon:'??',condition:'Good',seller:'M. Jain',location:'KIET Institute',college:'KIET',description:'Regularly serviced from authorised service centre. All papers complete. Leaving campus end of semester. RC, insurance, PUC all valid.',posted:'2d ago',views:230,type:'sell',badge:'hot'},
  {id:5,name:'Sony WF-1000XM5 Earbuds',price:0,category:'Tech',icon:'??',condition:'Fair',seller:'P. Bose',location:'KIET Institute',college:'KIET',description:'Left earbud occasionally drops connection. Right earbud works flawlessly. ANC still works. Giving away for free!',posted:'5h ago',views:88,type:'sell'},
  {id:6,name:'Calculus: Early Transcendentals – Stewart',price:400,category:'Academia',icon:'??',condition:'Good',seller:'S. Patel',location:'KIET Institute',college:'KIET',description:'Essential for first-year engineering mathematics. Minor highlighting in chapter 3 and 7. No torn pages.',posted:'3h ago',views:22,type:'sell',badge:'new'},
  {id:7,name:'JBL Flip 6 Speaker – For Rent',price:500,category:'Tech',icon:'??',condition:'Like New',seller:'V. Das',location:'KIET Institute',college:'KIET',description:'Available for daily rent. Heavy bass, waterproof. Ideal for hostel room parties or study sessions.',posted:'6h ago',views:76,type:'rent'},
  {id:8,name:'Hero Sprint 26T Bicycle',price:1500,category:'Rides',icon:'??',condition:'Fair',seller:'H. Khan',location:'KIET Institute',college:'KIET',description:'Reliable campus companion. Chain needs oiling, front tyre may need inflation daily.',posted:'1d ago',views:55,type:'sell'},
  {id:9,name:'LED Study Lamp – Rechargeable',price:250,category:'Living',icon:'??',condition:'Like New',seller:'T. Roy',location:'KIET Institute',college:'KIET',description:'3 brightness modes, USB-C charging, 8-hour battery life. Folds flat. Used only during finals.',posted:'12h ago',views:34,type:'sell',badge:'new'},
  {id:10,name:'Chemistry NCERT + JD Lee Bundle',price:350,category:'Academia',icon:'??',condition:'Good',seller:'N. Gupta',location:'KIET Institute',college:'KIET',description:'Both books together. JD Lee has sticky notes with important reactions. NCERT is clean.',posted:'8h ago',views:19,type:'sell'},
  {id:11,name:'Wacom Intuos Drawing Tablet',price:3500,category:'Tech',icon:'??',condition:'Good',seller:'D. Mehta',location:'KIET Institute',college:'KIET',description:'Small size, USB. Pen works perfectly. Used for design projects. Includes original pen and extra nibs.',posted:'2d ago',views:67,type:'sell',badge:'hot'},
  {id:12,name:'Foldable Study Table',price:600,category:'Living',icon:'??',condition:'Good',seller:'L. Kapoor',location:'KIET Institute',college:'KIET',description:'Adjustable height, foldable legs. Fits perfectly on hostel bed. Minor scuff on surface, structurally perfect.',posted:'3d ago',views:38,type:'sell'},
  {id:13,name:'DSA Notes – Handwritten + Typed',price:100,category:'Academia',icon:'??',condition:'Like New',seller:'Sneha J.',location:'KIET Institute',college:'KIET',description:'Complete Data Structures notes. Arrays, trees, graphs, DP. Great for placements.',posted:'5h ago',views:113,type:'sell'},
  {id:14,name:'Formal Suit Rental (M/L)',price:200,category:'Attire',icon:'??',condition:'Like New',seller:'Rahul Y.',location:'KIET Institute',college:'KIET',description:'Available for rent per day. Perfect for placements and seminars.',posted:'12h ago',views:41,type:'rent'},
  {id:15,name:'MuscleBlaze Whey Protein 1kg',price:700,category:'Living',icon:'??',condition:'Like New',seller:'Kunal B.',location:'KIET Institute',college:'KIET',description:'Opened once, ~900g remaining. Chocolate flavour.',posted:'4h ago',views:36,type:'sell'},
  {id:16,name:'GATE 2024 CS Prep Books (Set of 5)',price:500,category:'Academia',icon:'??',condition:'Good',seller:'Amit J.',location:'KIET Institute',college:'KIET',description:'Made Easy + Previous Years. Good annotations. Perfect for GATE preparation.',posted:'2d ago',views:89,type:'sell'},
];

// --- STATE ---
let user = null;
let cart = [];
let wishlist = [];
let activeCat = 'all';
let conditions = [];
let chips = {free:false,rentOnly:false,likeNew:false,myCollege:false};
let viewMode = 'grid';
let authMode = 'login';
let sellType = 'sell';
let detailItem = null;
let chatHistories = {};
let chatDetId = null;
let detailTab = 'desc';
let toastId = 0;

// --- TOAST ---
function toast(msg, type='default') {
  const id = ++toastId;
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'toast ' + type;
  el.textContent = msg;
  document.getElementById('toastStack').appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 3000);
}

// --- AUTH ---
function openAuthModal() {
  switchAuthTab('login');
  document.getElementById('authBg').classList.add('open');
}
function closeAuthOutside(e) {
  if (e.target === document.getElementById('authBg')) document.getElementById('authBg').classList.remove('open');
}
function switchAuthTab(mode) {
  authMode = mode;
  document.getElementById('atab-login').classList.toggle('active', mode==='login');
  document.getElementById('atab-register').classList.toggle('active', mode==='register');
  document.getElementById('authNameField').style.display = mode==='register' ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('authTitle').textContent = mode==='login' ? 'Welcome back' : 'Join CIRQL ??';
  document.getElementById('authSub').textContent = mode==='login' ? 'Log in to your campus account' : 'Create your student account';
  document.getElementById('authSubmitBtn').textContent = mode==='login' ? 'Log In ?' : 'Create Account ?';
  document.getElementById('authAltText').innerHTML = mode==='login'
    ? "Don't have an account? <a onclick=\"switchAuthTab('register')\">Sign up free</a>"
    : "Already have one? <a onclick=\"switchAuthTab('login')\">Log in</a>";
}
function detectCollege(email) {
  const el = document.getElementById('collegeDetect');
  if (!email.includes('@')) { el.style.display='none'; return; }
  const domain = email.split('@')[1] || '';
  let college = '';
  for (const k in COLLEGE_MAP) { if (domain.includes(k)) { college = COLLEGE_MAP[k]; break; } }
  if (!college && domain.includes('.')) { const p = domain.split('.'); college = p[0].charAt(0).toUpperCase()+p[0].slice(1)+' University'; }
  if (college) { document.getElementById('collegeDetectText').textContent = college+' detected'; el.style.display='block'; }
  else { el.style.display='none'; }
}
function submitAuth() {
  const email = document.getElementById('aEmail').value.trim();
  const pass = document.getElementById('aPass').value;
  const name = document.getElementById('aName')?.value?.trim() || '';
  if (!email.includes('@')) { toast('Valid college email required', 'error'); return; }
  if (pass.length < 6) { toast('Password must be at least 6 characters', 'error'); return; }
  if (authMode === 'register' && !name) { toast('Name is required', 'error'); return; }
  const domain = email.split('@')[1] || '';
  let college = 'Your College';
  for (const k in COLLEGE_MAP) { if (domain.includes(k)) { college = COLLEGE_MAP[k]; break; } }
  if (college === 'Your College') { const p = domain.split('.'); college = p[0].charAt(0).toUpperCase()+p[0].slice(1)+' University'; }
  const displayName = authMode === 'register' ? name : (name || email.split('@')[0]);
  const init = displayName.split(' ').map(w=>w[0]).join('').slice(0,2).toUpperCase();
  user = {name:displayName, email, college, init};
  document.getElementById('authBg').classList.remove('open');
  updateNavForUser();
  toast('Welcome, '+displayName.split(' ')[0]+'! ??', 'success');
}
function logout() {
  user = null; cart = []; wishlist = [];
  updateNavForUser();
  closeDrop();
  toast('Logged out successfully');
  renderListings();
}
function updateNavForUser() {
  const loggedIn = !!user;
  document.getElementById('loginBtn').style.display = loggedIn ? 'none' : '';
  document.getElementById('signupBtn').style.display = loggedIn ? 'none' : '';
  document.getElementById('cartBtn').style.display = loggedIn ? 'flex' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('profileDrop').style.display = loggedIn ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('fabPost').classList.toggle('show', loggedIn);
  if (loggedIn) document.getElementById('profileBtn').textContent = user.init;
  updateCartBadge();
}
function updateCartBadge() {
  const total = cart.reduce((s,c)=>s+c.qty,0);
  const badge = document.getElementById('cartCount');
  if (total > 0) { badge.textContent = total; badge.style.display = 'flex'; }
  else { badge.style.display = 'none'; }
}

// --- DROPDOWN ---
function toggleProfileDrop() { document.getElementById('profileDrop').classList.toggle('open'); }
function closeDrop() { document.getElementById('profileDrop').classList.remove('open'); }
document.addEventListener('click', e => {
  const pd = document.getElementById('profileDrop');
  if (pd && !pd.contains(e.target)) closeDrop();
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    ['authBg','sellBg','detailBg'].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id)?.classList.remove('open'));
    closeDrop();
  }
});

// --- CATEGORIES ---
function buildCatPills() {
  document.getElementById('catPills').innerHTML = CATEGORIES.map(c =>
    `<button class="cat-pill${activeCat===c.id?' active':''}" onclick="setActiveCat('${c.id}')"><span>${c.icon}</span>${c.label}</button>`
  ).join('');
}
function buildSidebarCats() {
  const counts = {};
  LISTINGS.forEach(l => { counts[l.category] = (counts[l.category]||0)+1; });
  document.getElementById('sidebarCats').innerHTML = CATEGORIES.filter(c=>c.id!=='all').map(c =>
    `<button class="filter-item${activeCat===c.id?' selected':''}" onclick="setActiveCat('${c.id}')">
      <div class="filter-item-left"><span>${c.icon}</span>${c.label}</div>
      <span class="filter-count">${counts[c.id]||0}</span>
    </button>`
  ).join('');
  document.getElementById('condList').innerHTML = ['Like New','Good','Fair','Poor'].map(c =>
    `<div class="cond-item" onclick="toggleCond('${c}')">
      <div class="cond-checkbox${conditions.includes(c)?' checked':''}">${conditions.includes(c)?'?':''}</div>
      ${c}
    </div>`
  ).join('');
}
function setActiveCat(id) {
  activeCat = id;
  buildCatPills();
  buildSidebarCats();
  renderListings();
  document.querySelector('.main').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
}
function toggleCond(c) {
  const idx = conditions.indexOf(c);
  if (idx > -1) conditions.splice(idx,1); else conditions.push(c);
  buildSidebarCats();
  renderListings();
}
function toggleChip(k) {
  if (k === 'myCollege' && !user) { openAuthModal(); return; }
  chips[k] = !chips[k];
  document.getElementById('fc-'+k).classList.toggle('on', chips[k]);
  renderListings();
}

// --- FILTERING ---
function getFiltered() {
  let list = [...LISTINGS];
  if (activeCat !== 'all') list = list.filter(i => i.category === activeCat);
  const q = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (q) list = list.filter(i => i.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || i.description.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  const catFilter = document.getElementById('searchCat').value;
  if (catFilter !== 'all') list = list.filter(i => i.category === catFilter);
  const pMin = parseFloat(document.getElementById('priceMin')?.value) || 0;
  const pMax = parseFloat(document.getElementById('priceMax')?.value) || Infinity;
  if (pMin > 0 || pMax < Infinity) list = list.filter(i => i.price >= pMin && i.price <= pMax);
  if (conditions.length) list = list.filter(i => conditions.includes(i.condition));
  if (chips.free) list = list.filter(i => i.price === 0);
  if (chips.rentOnly) list = list.filter(i => i.type === 'rent');
  if (chips.likeNew) list = list.filter(i => i.condition === 'Like New');
  if (chips.myCollege && user) list = list.filter(i => i.college === user.college.split(' ')[0]);
  const sort = document.getElementById('sortSel')?.value || 'recent';
  if (sort === 'low') list.sort((a,b) => a.price - b.price);
  else if (sort === 'high') list.sort((a,b) => b.price - a.price);
  else if (sort === 'popular') list.sort((a,b) => b.views - a.views);
  else list.sort((a,b) => b.id - a.id);
  return list;
}

// --- RENDER ---
function onSearch() { renderListings(); }
function setView(v) {
  viewMode = v;
  document.getElementById('vbGrid').classList.toggle('active', v==='grid');
  document.getElementById('vbList').classList.toggle('active', v==='list');
  renderListings();
}

function condClass(c) {
  if (c==='Like New') return 'like-new';
  if (c==='Good') return 'good';
  if (c==='Fair') return 'fair';
  return '';
}

function renderListings() {
  const container = document.getElementById('listingsContainer');
  // skeleton
  container.innerHTML = `<div class="${viewMode==='grid'?'listings-grid':'listings-list'}">
    ${Array(8).fill(0).map(()=>`<div class="skel-card"><div class="skel skel-img"></div><div class="skel-body"><div class="skel skel-line" style="margin-bottom:8px"></div><div class="skel skel-line s"></div></div></div>`).join('')}
  </div>`;
  setTimeout(() => {
    const list = getFiltered();
    document.getElementById('resultsText').innerHTML = `<strong>${list.length}</strong> listing${list.length===1?'':'s'} found`;
    if (!list.length) {
      container.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-state"><div class="es-icon">??</div><div class="es-title">No listings found</div><div class="es-desc">Try adjusting your search or filters</div></div>`;
      return;
    }
    if (viewMode === 'grid') {
      container.innerHTML = `<div class="listings-grid">${list.map((item,i) => buildGridCard(item,i)).join('')}</div>`;
    } else {
      container.innerHTML = `<div class="listings-list">${list.map((item,i) => buildListCard(item,i)).join('')}</div>`;
    }
  }, 280);
}

function fmtPrice(item) {
  if (item.price === 0) return '<span style="color:#15803d;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:18px;font-weight:800">Free</span>';
  return `<div class="card-price">?${item.price.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div>${item.type==='rent'?'<div class="card-price-sub">per day</div>':''}`;
}

function getBadge(item) {
  if (item.price === 0) return `<span class="badge badge-free">FREE</span>`;
  if (item.type === 'rent') return `<span class="badge badge-rent">RENT</span>`;
  if (item.badge === 'hot') return `<span class="badge badge-hot">?? Hot</span>`;
  if (item.badge === 'new') return `<span class="badge badge-new">New</span>`;
  return '';
}

function buildGridCard(item, i) {
  const inWish = wishlist.includes(item.id);
  const inCart = cart.find(c=>c.id===item.id);
  return `<div class="prod-card" style="animation-delay:${i*25}ms" onclick="openDetail(${item.id})">
    <div class="card-img">
      <div class="card-img-bg"></div>
      ${getBadge(item)}
      <button class="wishlist-btn${inWish?' liked':''}" onclick="event.stopPropagation();toggleWish(${item.id})">${inWish?'?':'?'}</button>
      <span>${item.icon}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="card-body">
      ${fmtPrice(item)}
      <div class="card-name">${item.name}</div>
      <div class="card-meta">
        <span class="card-loc">?? ${item.location}</span>
        <span class="card-cond ${condClass(item.condition)}">${item.condition}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="card-footer">
      <button class="add-cart-btn${inCart?' in-cart':''}" onclick="event.stopPropagation();addToCart(${item.id})" ${inCart?'disabled':''}>
        ${inCart?'? In Cart':'?? Add to Cart'}
      </button>
      <button class="contact-btn" onclick="event.stopPropagation();openDetailChat(${item.id})">??</button>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

function buildListCard(item, i) {
  const inWish = wishlist.includes(item.id);
  const inCart = cart.find(c=>c.id===item.id);
  return `<div class="list-card" onclick="openDetail(${item.id})">
    <div class="list-card-img">
      ${getBadge(item)}
      <span>${item.icon}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="list-card-body">
      <div class="list-card-top">
        <div class="list-card-info">
          <div class="list-card-name">${item.name}</div>
          <span class="card-cond ${condClass(item.condition)}">${item.condition}</span>
          <div class="list-card-desc">${item.description}</div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="list-card-price">${item.price===0?'Free':'?'+item.price.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div>
          ${item.type==='rent'?'<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--gray-500);text-align:right">per day</div>':''}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="list-card-bottom">
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px">
          <span class="card-loc" style="font-size:12px;color:var(--gray-500)">?? ${item.location}</span>
          <span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--gray-500)">? ${item.posted}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="list-card-actions">
          <button class="add-cart-btn${inCart?' in-cart':''}" onclick="event.stopPropagation();addToCart(${item.id})" ${inCart?'disabled':''} style="height:34px;font-size:12px">
            ${inCart?'? In Cart':'?? Add to Cart'}
          </button>
          <button class="contact-btn" onclick="event.stopPropagation();toggleWish(${item.id})" style="height:34px;font-size:14px;color:${inWish?'var(--danger)':'var(--gray-500)'}">${inWish?'?':'?'}</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

// --- WISHLIST ---
function toggleWish(id) {
  if (!user) { openAuthModal(); return; }
  const idx = wishlist.indexOf(id);
  if (idx > -1) { wishlist.splice(idx,1); toast('Removed from wishlist'); }
  else { wishlist.push(id); toast('Saved to wishlist ?', 'success'); }
  renderListings();
  if (document.getElementById('detailBg').classList.contains('open') && detailItem?.id === id) {
    openDetail(id);
  }
}

// --- CART ---
function addToCart(id) {
  if (!user) { openAuthModal(); return; }
  const item = LISTINGS.find(i => i.id === id);
  const ex = cart.find(c => c.id === id);
  if (ex) { toast('Already in cart!', 'error'); return; }
  cart.push({...item, qty:1});
  updateCartBadge();
  toast('Added to cart ??', 'success');
  renderListings();
}
function removeFromCart(id) {
  cart = cart.filter(c => c.id !== id);
  updateCartBadge();
  renderCart();
}
function changeQty(id, delta) {
  const item = cart.find(c => c.id === id);
  if (!item) return;
  item.qty = Math.max(1, item.qty + delta);
  renderCart();
}
function toggleCart() {
  const d = document.getElementById('cartDrawer');
  const o = document.getElementById('cartOverlay');
  d.classList.toggle('open');
  o.classList.toggle('open');
  if (d.classList.contains('open')) renderCart();
}
function renderCart() {
  const body = document.getElementById('cartBody');
  const footer = document.getElementById('cartFooter');
  if (!cart.length) {
    body.innerHTML = `<div class="drawer-empty"><div class="drawer-empty-icon">??</div><p>Your cart is empty.<br/>Browse listings and add items!</p></div>`;
    footer.style.display = 'none';
    return;
  }
  body.innerHTML = cart.map(item => `<div class="cart-item">
    <div class="cart-item-icon">${item.icon}</div>
    <div class="cart-item-info">
      <div class="cart-item-name">${item.name}</div>
      <div class="cart-item-price">?${(item.price * item.qty).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div>
      <div class="cart-item-meta">Seller: ${item.seller} · ${item.location}</div>
      <div class="cart-qty">
        <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${item.id},-1)">-</button>
        <span class="qty-num">${item.qty}</span>
        <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${item.id},1)">+</button>
        <button class="cart-item-remove" onclick="removeFromCart(${item.id})">Remove</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>`).join('');
  const subtotal = cart.reduce((s,c) => s + c.price*c.qty, 0);
  document.getElementById('cartSummary').innerHTML = `
    <div class="summary-row"><span>Subtotal (${cart.length} items)</span><span>?${subtotal.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span></div>
    <div class="summary-row"><span>Platform Fee</span><span style="color:#15803d">?0 (Free!)</span></div>
    <div class="summary-row total"><span>Total</span><span>?${subtotal.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span></div>`;
  footer.style.display = 'block';
}
function checkout() {
  toast('Purchase request sent! Sellers will contact you for meetup ??', 'success');
  cart = [];
  updateCartBadge();
  renderCart();
}

// --- DETAIL ---
function openDetail(id) {
  const item = LISTINGS.find(i => i.id === id);
  if (!item) return;
  detailItem = item;
  if (!chatHistories[id]) chatHistories[id] = [{from:'seller',text:'Hi! The item is still available ??',time:'Now'}];
  document.getElementById('detHeaderTitle').textContent = item.name;
  renderDetailContent('desc');
  document.getElementById('detailBg').classList.add('open');
}
function openDetailChat(id) { openDetail(id); setTimeout(() => renderDetailContent('chat'), 50); }
function closeDetail(e) { if (e.target === document.getElementById('detailBg')) document.getElementById('detailBg').classList.remove('open'); }
function renderDetailContent(tab) {
  detailTab = tab;
  const item = detailItem;
  const inWish = wishlist.includes(item.id);
  const inCart = cart.find(c=>c.id===item.id);
  const priceHtml = item.price===0?'<span style="color:#15803d">Free</span>':('?'+item.price.toLocaleString('en-IN'));
  const chatHtml = user ? `<div class="chat-box">
    <div class="chat-msgs" id="chatMsgsEl">${(chatHistories[item.id]||[]).map(m=>`<div class="bubble ${m.from==='me'?'mine':'theirs'}">${m.text}<div class="bubble-time">${m.time}</div></div>`).join('')}</div>
    <div class="chat-input-row">
      <input class="chat-input" id="chatInputEl" placeholder="Type a message…" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')sendMsg()"/>
      <button class="chat-send" onclick="sendMsg()">
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><path d="M22 2L11 13M22 2L15 22l-4-9-9-4 20-7z"/></svg>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>` : `<div style="text-align:center;padding:24px"><div style="font-size:32px;opacity:.2;margin-bottom:12px">??</div><p style="color:var(--gray-500);margin-bottom:14px">Login to chat with the seller</p><button class="auth-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('detailBg').classList.remove('open');openAuthModal()" style="width:auto;padding:0 28px;height:42px;border-radius:var(--radius)">Login to Chat</button></div>`;
  document.getElementById('detailContent').innerHTML = `
    <div><div class="modal-img">${item.icon}</div></div>
    <div>
      <div class="modal-price">${priceHtml}</div>
      <div class="modal-name">${item.name}</div>
      <div class="seller-card">
        <div class="seller-avatar">${item.seller.charAt(0)}</div>
        <div><div class="seller-name">${item.seller}</div><div class="seller-loc">?? ${item.location} · Posted ${item.posted}</div></div>
        <div style="margin-left:auto;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#23d160;flex-shrink:0"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-chat-tabs">
        <button class="mct${tab==='desc'?' active':''}" onclick="renderDetailContent('desc')">Description</button>
        <button class="mct${tab==='chat'?' active':''}" onclick="renderDetailContent('chat')">?? Chat</button>
      </div>
      ${tab==='desc'?`<div class="modal-desc">${item.description}</div>
        <table class="detail-table">
          <tr><td>Category</td><td>${item.category}</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Condition</td><td>${item.condition}</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Type</td><td>${item.type==='rent'?'For Rent':'For Sale'}</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Views</td><td>${item.views}</td></tr>
        </table>
        <div class="modal-actions">
          <button class="modal-cart-btn${inCart?' ':''}" onclick="addToCart(${item.id})" ${inCart?'disabled':''} style="${inCart?'background:var(--accent);color:#000':''}">
            ${inCart?'? Added to Cart':'?? Add to Cart'}
          </button>
          <button class="modal-contact-btn" onclick="toggleWish(${item.id})" style="color:${inWish?'var(--danger)':''};border-color:${inWish?'var(--danger)':''}">
            ${inWish?'? Saved to Wishlist':'? Save to Wishlist'}
          </button>
        </div>`
      : chatHtml}
    </div>`;
  if (tab==='chat') { const el=document.getElementById('chatMsgsEl'); if(el) el.scrollTop=el.scrollHeight; }
}
function sendMsg() {
  if (!user || !detailItem) return;
  const inp = document.getElementById('chatInputEl');
  const txt = inp?.value?.trim();
  if (!txt) return;
  if (!chatHistories[detailItem.id]) chatHistories[detailItem.id] = [];
  chatHistories[detailItem.id].push({from:'me',text:txt,time:'Now'});
  inp.value = '';
  renderDetailContent('chat');
  setTimeout(() => {
    chatHistories[detailItem.id].push({from:'seller',text:"Sounds good! Let's meet near the canteen tomorrow noon.",time:'Just now'});
    renderDetailContent('chat');
  }, 800);
}

// --- POST ---
function openSellModal() { document.getElementById('sellBg').classList.add('open'); }
function closeSellOutside(e) { if (e.target === document.getElementById('sellBg')) document.getElementById('sellBg').classList.remove('open'); }
function switchSellTab(t) {
  sellType = t;
  ['sell','rent','give'].forEach(x => document.getElementById('stab-'+x).classList.toggle('active', x===t));
  document.getElementById('sellPriceField').style.display = t==='give' ? 'none' : 'block';
  document.getElementById('sellPriceLbl').textContent = t==='rent' ? 'Rent Price (per day)' : 'Selling Price';
}
function submitPost() {
  const name = document.getElementById('sName').value.trim();
  const price = document.getElementById('sPrice')?.value;
  const desc = document.getElementById('sDesc').value.trim();
  let valid = true;
  if (!name) { document.getElementById('errSName').style.display='block'; valid=false; } else { document.getElementById('errSName').style.display='none'; }
  if (sellType !== 'give' && !price) { document.getElementById('errSPrice').style.display='block'; valid=false; } else { document.getElementById('errSPrice').style.display='none'; }
  if (!desc) { document.getElementById('errSDesc').style.display='block'; valid=false; } else { document.getElementById('errSDesc').style.display='none'; }
  if (!valid) return;
  const cat = document.getElementById('sCat').value;
  LISTINGS.unshift({
    id:Date.now(), name, price:sellType==='give'?0:Number(price),
    category:cat, icon:CAT_ICONS[cat]||'??',
    condition:document.getElementById('sCond').value,
    seller:user.name, location:user.college, college:user.college.split(' ')[0],
    description:desc, posted:'Just now', views:0, type:sellType, badge:'new'
  });
  document.getElementById('sellBg').classList.remove('open');
  buildSidebarCats();
  renderListings();
  toast('Listing posted! ??', 'success');
  document.getElementById('sName').value=''; document.getElementById('sPrice').value=''; document.getElementById('sDesc').value='';
}

// --- HERO PREVIEW ---
function buildHeroPreview() {
  const hot = LISTINGS.filter(l=>l.badge==='hot'||l.views>50).slice(0,3);
  document.getElementById('heroPreview').innerHTML = hot.map(item=>`
    <div class="mini-listing" onclick="openDetail(${item.id})">
      <div class="mini-icon">${item.icon}</div>
      <div class="mini-info">
        <div class="mini-title">${item.name}</div>
        <div class="mini-meta">?? ${item.location} · ${item.posted}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="mini-price">${item.price===0?'Free':'?'+item.price.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div>
    </div>`).join('');
}

// --- NOTIFICATIONS ---
async function enableNotif() {
  if (!('Notification' in window)) { toast('Notifications not supported in this browser', 'error'); document.getElementById('notif-bar').style.display='none'; return; }
  const p = await Notification.requestPermission();
  if (p === 'granted') { new Notification('CIRQL Notifications ON! ??', {body:'You will now get alerts for new campus listings!'}); }
  document.getElementById('notif-bar').style.display = 'none';
  toast(p==='granted'?'Notifications enabled! ??':'Notifications dismissed', p==='granted'?'success':'default');
}

// --- NEWSLETTER ---
function subscribeNl() {
  const email = document.getElementById('nlEmail').value.trim();
  if (!email.includes('@')) { toast('Enter a valid email address', 'error'); return; }
  document.getElementById('nlForm').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('nlDone').style.display = 'block';
  toast('Subscribed! Welcome aboard ??', 'success');
}

// --- MISC ---
function resetHome() { activeCat='all'; document.getElementById('searchInput').value=''; buildCatPills(); renderListings(); window.scrollTo(0,0); }

// --- INIT ---
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  buildCatPills();
  buildSidebarCats();
  buildHeroPreview();
  renderListings();
});
</script>

						var url = elem.href.replace(/(&|\?)_cacheOverride=\d+/, '');
						elem.href = url + (url.indexOf('?') >= 0 ? '&' : '?') + '_cacheOverride=' + (new Date().valueOf());
					}
					parent.appendChild(elem);

			var protocol = window.location.protocol === 'http:' ? 'ws://' : 'wss://';
